scenario.name: Salesforce Security, Mandiant & MITRE — SaaS Connected App OAuth Scope Escalation & Bulk API 2.0 Export Audit
scenario.overview: Imagine a lively downtown city street intersection with painted zebra crosswalks, glowing red-yellow-green traffic lights, corner shop awnings, and passing yellow taxis. At the busy downtown street corner, an impostor wearing a reflective utility vest kneels beside the metal traffic-signal control cabinet while pedestrians cross the street. In this real-world scenario, the intruder quietly copies a trusted access pass from the traffic officer's station, then quietly copies a trusted access pass from the traffic officer's station. The city intersection camera and municipal traffic control board detect the impossible all-green light timing and dispatch a traffic officer immediately. In this scenario (T1528, Salesforce Security, Mandiant & MITRE, SaaS Connected App OAuth Scope Escalation & Bulk API 2.0 Export Audit), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: unverified OAuth Connected App Consent, then asynchronous Bulk API 2.0 Query Job Creation, then bulk CSV Result Batch Download. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering Unverified OAuth Connected App Consent, then Asynchronous Bulk API 2.0 Query Job Creation, then Bulk CSV Result Batch Download, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection pivots on SIEM Event 200 correlated across the documented kill chain.

stages.title: Stage 1: Unverified OAuth Connected App Consent & Refresh Token Issuance
stages.subtitle: Persistence (T1528 - Steal Application Access Token)
stages.description: At the busy downtown street corner, an impostor wearing a reflective utility vest kneels beside the metal traffic-signal control cabinet while pedestrians cross the street. Specifically in Step 1, the intruder quietly copies a trusted access pass from the traffic officer's station while everyday visitors and the traffic officer go about their routine. When an organization permits "All users may self-authorize" on OAuth Connected Apps, an attacker social-engineers a user or uses stolen credentials to authorize a custom Connected App requesting api and refresh_token (offline_access) scopes, logged in OauthToken and LoginHistory (logged in Linux Audit Event 200 with EventType=LoginHistory , Remote Access 2.0, ConnectedAppName=DataSync_Connector, GrantedScopes=api, refresh_token , offline_access so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). Under the hood, the observed step executes SELECT UserId, AppName, UseCount, LastUsedDate FROM OauthToken WHERE AppName = 'DataSync_Connector' (which executes a structured SQL query or database administration command , SELECT UserId, AppName, UseCount, LastUsedDate FROM OauthToken WHERE AppName = so that pivots from database query access or SQL injection to direct operating system command execution or authentication bypass , T1528 during "Unverified OAuth Connected App Consent & Refresh Token Issuance" under the database daemon's service account). Next, the follow-up artifact SELECT Application, Status, SourceIp, LoginType FROM LoginHistory WHERE LoginType = 'Remote Access 2.0' runs (which executes a structured SQL query or database administration command , SELECT Application, Status, SourceIp, LoginType FROM LoginHistory WHERE LoginT so that pivots from database query access or SQL injection to direct operating system command execution or authentication bypass , T1528 during "Unverified OAuth Connected App Consent & Refresh Token Issuance" under the database daemon's service account). On the diagram, follow Step #1 / Link #1 (#1→ POST /services/oauth2/token (Remote Access 2.0 Connected App: DataSync_Connector) / ⇠#1 ACK 200) from Node ① (#1 External OAuth Client) to Node ② (#2 Perimeter Firewall & NDR Tap), monitored by Node ⑥ (#6 Bulk API 2.0 (/jobs/query CRM Objects)).

stages.title: Stage 3: Bulk CSV Result Batch Download (/jobs/query/<id>/results) & OauthToken Revocation
stages.subtitle: Exfiltration (T1567 - Exfiltration Over Web Service)
stages.description: Traffic signals flip out of rhythm across the city intersection, creating instant confusion that lets an unmarked courier slip past the corner storefront unseen. In this final step inside the city street, the intruder quietly copies a trusted access pass from the traffic officer's station until the intersection traffic camera catches the mismatch. Once job state transitions to JobComplete, the client streams CSV batches via GET /services/data/v59.0/jobs/query/7508c000008AbCd/results. Defenders revoke the OauthToken record and enforce IP range restrictions on the Connected App profile (logged in Linux Audit Event 200 with ResultDownloadUri=/services/data/v59.0/jobs/query/7508c000008AbCd/results, ResponseSizeBytes=14,820,412 bytes , CSV stream, AnomalyEvent=ApiAnomalyEventStore Triggered so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). Under the hood, the observed step executes SELECT JobId, RecordsProcessed,TotalProcessingTime FROM BulkApiResultEventStore WHERE JobId = '7508c000008AbCd' (which executes a structured SQL query or database administration command , SELECT JobId, RecordsProcessed,TotalProcessingTime FROM BulkApiResultEventStor so that pivots from database query access or SQL injection to direct operating system command execution or authentication bypass , T1567 during "Bulk CSV Result Batch Download , /jobs/query/<id>/results & OauthToken Revocation" under the database daemon's service account). Next, the follow-up artifact DELETE /services/oauth2/revoke?token=<refresh_token> runs (which Transmits a crafted HTTP request , DELETE /services/oauth2/revoke?token=<refresh_token> targeting a web server, reverse proxy, or appliance managem so that triggers the web/appliance vulnerability, authentication bypass, or C2 communication channel , T1567 required to accomplish "Bulk CSV Result Batch Download , /jobs/query/<id>/results & OauthToken Revocation"). On the diagram, follow Step #3 / Link #3 (#3→ GET /services/data/v59.0/jobs/query/7508c000008AbCd/results?maxRecords=50000 / ⇠#3 ACK 200) from Node ③ (#3 Salesforce OAuth /services/oauth2/token) to Node ④ (#4 Connected App (api + refresh_token)), monitored by Node ⑥ (#6 Bulk API 2.0 (/jobs/query CRM Objects)).

Enforce Trusted IP Ranges on Connected Apps, set Refresh Token Policy to "Expire refresh token after N hours", and forward Salesforce Shield Real-Time Event Monitoring (ApiAnomalyEventStore) to SIEM.
